document_transport.browser_javascript_observation: Current Toronto AIC JavaScript POSTs numeric folderRsn to the two api.toronto.ca/aic read endpoints and sends a browser-generated g-recaptcha-response header.
document_transport.server_probe_result: No-token, blank-token and fake-token probes returned HTTP 400 for both read endpoints.
document_transport.legacy_transport_result: The stored legacy secure.toronto.ca/AIC encrypted URLs returned HTTP 403 for almost all current applications in the attempted corpus partitions.

representative_invalid_partition.interpretation: This partition is retained only as transport diagnostics and is not counted as document-corpus coverage.

coverage_caveat.warning: Zero parsed AIC documents is not evidence that applications have no supporting documents.
